tei:div.tei:p: (shrī)༄༅// 'dod khams dbang phyug dmag zor rgyal mo'i sgrub thabs gtor chog bzhugs so// ༄༅// 'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// bgegs dpung 'joms mdzad bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed// dpal ldan bstan srung dmag zor rgyal mo la// snying nas 'dud do srid mtha'i bar du skyongs// 'dir rgyal ba thams cad kyi yum gcig lha mo dbyangs can ma drag mo'i skur bstan pa/ dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i sgrub thabs ngag tu 'don bde ba gtso bor byas te brjod par bya'o// de la thog mar/ rang nyid dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs par bsams la/ nang mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭi wi kri tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu ba dan gyi mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i steng du āḥlas mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa dkar po/ de'i nang gi shar du bhrūm̐ las byung ba'i ba lang gi sha gos mtshan pa/ lhor oṃ las byung ba'i khyi'i sha kus mtshan pa/ nub tu dzriṃ las byung ba'i glang po che'i sha das mtshan pa/ byang du kham̐ las byung ba'i rta'i sha has mtshan pa/ dbus su hūm̐ las byung ba'i mi'i sha nas mtshan pa/ shar lhor lam̐ las byung ba'i dri chen bis mtshan pa/ lho nub tu mām̐ las byung ba'i rakta ras mtshan pa/ nub byang du pam̐ las byung ba'i byang sems dkar po shus mtshan pa/ byang shar du tām̐ las byung ba'i rkang mar mas mtshan pa/ dbus su lam̐ las byung ba'i dri chu mus mtshan pa/ de dag gi steng du oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po gsum steng nas steng du brtsegs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/

rlung la phog rlung g.yos me sbar/ thod pa'i rdzas rnams zhu zhing 'khol bar gyur/ yi ge gsum las 'od zer rim pa bzhin du 'phros pas/ sku rdo rje/ gsung rdo rje/ thugs rdo rje rnams bkug nas yi ge gsum la rim gyis thim pa rnams thod par lhung nas zhu bas/ hūm̐ gis kha dog dri nus kyi skyon sbyangs/ āḥs bdud rtsir rtogs par byas/ oṃ gyis mang por sbar zhing spel bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/ de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hrīḥṣṭ+rīḥs bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las aḥlas byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa rnams rang bzhin bde stong*/ rnam pa mchod rdzas/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā dyaṃ/ badzra puṣpe/ badzra dhū paṃ/ badzra ā lo ke/ badzra gandhe/ badzra nai wi dyā/ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐/ oṃ rū pa/ shabda/ gandhe/ ra sa/ sparshe āḥhūm̐/ zhes rol mo dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab/ de nas legs par bshams pa'i gtor ma'ang nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlab/ de nas/ chos skyong 'khor bcas bskyed pa ni/ bhyoḥrakmo bhyoḥrakmo bhyoḥbhyoḥrakmo thun bhyoḥkha la raka chen mo/ rakmo a bya ta bya thun bhyoḥ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyoḥhūm̐/ zhes pa lan gsum bzlas pa'i rjes su/ hrīḥṣṭ+rīḥs bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du khrag zhag 'khrug pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus su/ rlung nag 'tshub ma'i gur gyi nang du/ dre'u rkyang ser gwa pa srin po'i thod pa'i sga dang pags pas g.yogs shing*/ gong smed dang srab mthur gdug pa'i sbrul las byas pa/ de'i steng du bhyoḥlas dpal ldan dmag zor gyi rgyal mo re ma ti sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/

phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i be con dam nyams kyi klad la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thun dang khrag gis gang ba'i nal thod thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhal rab tu gdangs shing che ba rnon po bzhi gtsigs nas mi ro rangs po za zhing a la la'i gad mo 'brug ltar sgrog pa/ spyan gsum dmar zhing zlum pa glog ltar 'khyug cing khro gnyer shin tu bsdus pa/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes shing smin ma dang sma ra dus mtha'i me ltar rab tu 'bar ba/ snyan g.yas la seṅge dang*/ g.yon la sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu la brgyan cing*/ khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo bo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku la khrag gi thig le dang zhag gi zor ris dang*/ thal chen gyi tshom bus byugs shing*/ spyi bor zla ba dang*/ lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba/ dar nag gi lhab lhub dang*/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang*/ re ba nag pos stod g.yogs shing*/ stag gi pags pa rlon pa'i sham thabs la sbrul nyis gshibs kyi ska rags byas pa/ sga'i snga sha la nad rkyal dang*/ mtshon gyi gru gu phyi sha la 'phyang zhing*/ khram shing sked la gzer ba/ byang dmar gyi khres po dang*/ shwa rde dkar nag snga sha la 'phyang zhing*/ dbu la rma bya'i gdugs phub pa/ de'i 'khor du dus bzhi'i lha mo dang*/ ma mo dang*/ bdud dang*/ gshin rje dang*/ srin po dang*/ zhing skyong la sogs pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa dang*/ gzhan yang lha dang*/ klu dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ dri za dang*/ grul bum dang*/ mi'am ci dang*/ lto 'phye chen po la sogs pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje dang*/ gri gug dang*/ ral gri dang*/ dgra st+wa dang*/ mdung dang*/ lcags kyu dang*/ lcags kyi gsal shing me rab tu 'bar ba la sogs pa mtshon cha sna tshogs pa 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thams cad thod pa gdug pa'i khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi mig tu kṣiṃ/ rna bar dzriṃ/ snar kham̐/ lce ram̐/ dpral bar kam̐

lte bar sam̐/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ bdag nyid kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas byang shar mu le ding gi rgya mtsho chen po nas/ dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis spyan drangs/ spos sbyor bsreg rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas/ bhyoḥ dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma ti// dmag zor bstan pa'i bya ra ma// rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru// bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes ma// sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la// khyod kyis brten pa'i gnas bcas pa// 'di nas byang shar mtshams shed na// rtswa chu shing sogs med pa la// lung mang brgal ba'i pha rol na// byang thang dmar po skyo phyad pa// byang lam dmar po gya ma gyu// byang ri dmar po rngams shing 'jigs// gcan gzan mang po 'dur rgyug byed// 'dre bya sna tshogs skad sgrog cing*// gnam lcags ser chen sha ra ra// dug gi bu yug khyil li li// mu le ding gi mtsho nang na// bse mkhar smug po gru bzhi pa// zur bzhi smug po'i mchong las byas// kha bad sngon po'i g.yu las byas// rmang gzhi nag po'i lcags las byas// mi ro rta ro gcal du bkram// mi khrag rta khrag mtsho ru mer// ma mo 'bum dang sha za stong*// khrag 'thung bye ba'i tshogs 'khor rgyas// gzhal yas de yi nang shed na// ma mo kun gyi bdag mo bzhugs/ bhyoḥ sngon gyi gnas mchog dam pa nas// spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// 'dir gshegs rten la brtan par bzhugs// dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral du gsol// rdo rje 'chang gis mtshan btags pa// dmag dang zor gyi las la dgyes// dmag zor rgyal mo gshegs su gsol// 'dir gshegs rten la brtan par bzhugs// dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral du gsol// phyag na rdo rjes mtshan btags pa// gnod sbyin bshan nag re ma ti// spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// 'dir gshegs=

/dam nyams dgra bgegs= /rta mgrin rgyal pos mtshan btags pa// glog ma sprin sde gshegs su gsol// 'dir gshegs= /dam nyams dgra bgegs= /dbang phyug chen pos mtshan btags pa// sbas pa thal mdog gshegs su gsol// 'dir gshegs= /dam nyams= /na la tse yis mtshan btags pa// mi pham khro gnyer gshegs su gsol/ 'dir gshegs= /dam nyams= /bdud mo dbang med mtshan btags pa// ya mtshan 'phrul gyi gshog pa can// spyan 'dren= /'dir gshegs= /dam nyams= /re lde 'gong yag mtshan btags pa// srid gsum blo 'phrog gshegs su gsol// 'dir gshegs= /dam nyams= /dung skyong rgyal mos mtshan btags pa// gshin rje dmar 'dab phur pa'i lha// spyan 'dren gnas 'dir= /'dir gshegs= /dam nyams= /e ka dzwa ṭis mtshan btags pa// yakṣa nag mo re ma ti// spyan 'dren= /'dir gshegs= /dam nyams= /bhyoḥ rgya gar yul na bzhugs tsa na// ma mo wa shaṃ ku ru ma/spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// 'dir gshegs rten la brtan par bzhugs// dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral du gsol// hor gyi yul na bzhugs tsa na// hor mo gnyan gyi spun dgu'i gtso// spyan 'dren= /'dir gshegs= /dam nyams dgra= /mon gyi yul na bzhugs tsa na// mon mo spyi ring lan phran ma// spyan 'dren= /'dir gshegs= /dam nyams= /rgya nag yul na bzhugs tsa na// rgya mo sngon mo mgrin bzang ma// spyan= /'dir gshegs= /dam nyams= /bod kyi yul na bzhugs tsa na// ma gcig dpal ldan a phyi ma// spyan 'dren= /'dir gshegs= /dam nyams= /bar snang khams na bzhugs tsa na// nam mkha'i khams kyi dpal mo btsan// spyan 'dren= /'dir gshegs= /dam nyams= /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrungs tsa na// dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma ti// spyan 'dren= /'dir gshegs= /dam nyams= /bdud kyi yum la gshin rje'i lcam// bstan skyong rgyal mo gshegs su gsol// 'dir gshegs= /dam nyams= /bhyoḥ lha yi gtso mo mdzad tsa na// brgya byin sras mo u ma de// lha bran mang po'i 'khor dang bcas// sum cu rtsa gsum gnas nas gshegs// 'dir gshegs=

/dam nyams= /klu yi gtso mo mdzad tsa na// gtsug na'i bu mo nor 'dzin ma// klu bran mang po'i 'khor dang bcas// rol mtsho bdun gyi gnas nas gshegs// 'dir gshegs= /dam nyams= /gnod sbyin gtso mo mdzad tsa na// gang bzang bu mo gzi legs ma// gnod sbyin mang po'i 'khor dang bcas// bya dkar can gyi gnas nas gshegs// 'dir gshegs= /dam nyams= /bdud kyi gtso mo mdzad tsa na// 'gong yag sras mo dri ldan ma// bdud phrug mang po'i 'khor dang bcas// bdud mkhar rtse dgu'i gnas nas gshegs// 'dir gshegs= /dam nyams= /srin po'i gtso mo mdzad tsa na// zhabs la lcags sgrog rgyan du byas// srin mo mang po'i 'khor dang bcas// laṅka mgrin bcu'i gnas nas gshegs// 'dir gshegs= /dam nyams= /gshin rje'i gtso mo mdzad tsa na// mi bzad nag mo drag shul can// gshin rje mang po'i 'khor dang bcas// lcags mkhar sgo med gnas nas gshegs// 'dir gshegs rten la brtan par bzhugs// dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral du gsol// bhyoḥ ming brgya ma la mtshan stong ma// mtshan nas 'bod kyis gshegs su gsol// rdo rje 'chang sogs bla ma yis// ji ltar bka' bsgos dam bcas bzhin// da lta rnal 'byor bdag bskul gyis// bcol pa'i phrin las myur du sgrubs// dpon slob sde dang bcas pa rnams// lha mo khyod la gnyer du gtad// bcol lo ltos so mthu ma chung*// nyin gsum bya ra ma g.yel zhig /mtshan gsum mel tshe ma g.yel zhig /rgyun du lha mo khyod bsten no// bsten pa'i tshe na snying ma ring*// rgyun du lha mo khyod 'bod do// bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra// rgyun du lha mo khyod g.yab bo// g.yabs pa'i tshe na spyan ma brtul// rgyun du lha mo khyod bskul lo// bskul ba'i tshe na bang ma bul// rgyun du lha mo khyod rbad do// rbad pa'i tshe na mthu ma chung*// bhyoḥ dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma ti// khyod kyi spyi bo'i gtsug rum nas// nyi zla 'bar ba'i 'od zer 'phro// nag mo mi bzad cho 'phrul can// 'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang phyug ma// thugs dam dus bab da tshur spyon// e ā ra li hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥdzaḥ

nag mo gdug can dregs pa can// kun tu khyab pa'i gzugs ston ma// nag mo'i gtso mo dre'u rta chibs// 'dir byon dre'u rta'i gdan la bzhugs// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ za byed nag mo mche ba can// rgod byed ha ha nag mo khyod// gsod la dga' bar byed pa mo// bdag ni brda yis phyag bgyid do// dkyus ma la ni gong gi shlo ka gnyis po bzhag nas/ sku gsum lhun grub thugs rje mthar phyin yang*// srid gsum gdug pa 'dul phyir khros pa'i sku// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan srung chen mo la// sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo// zhes phyag bya/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri āḥhūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas/ lus gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje 'jigs byed yum dang bcas pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ bhyoḥ bdag gis dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa las// legs par byung ba'i mchod yon mtha' yas pa// dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bstan dgra ma lus brlag par mdzod// oṃ kā lī de wī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du mchod phreng gi tshigs su bcad pa gong bzhin la/ mchod yon gyi gnas su/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ de bzhin du/ gzugs mchog sgra snyan/ dri mchog ro mchog reg bya/ rnams bcug arghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dyā/ shabda/ de bzhin du/ rū pa/ shabda/ gandhe/ ra sa/ sparshe/ rnams bcug la phul/ de nas nang mchod 'bul ba ni/

mchod do phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal du= ā tsarya dmar po'i= lce 'byung gnas bzang po'i= snubs rgyal ba ye shes kyi zhal du= zhang pradzñā gu ru'i= sras saṃ gha bha dra'i zhal du= sras 'od po che'i zhal du= sras rdo rje rtse mo'i zhal du= zhang ding ri ba nyi ma 'od kyi zhal du= bstan bzang ba rin chen rnam rgyal gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bsam gling pa rin po che sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i= 'jam dbyangs 'khon ston gyi zhal= byang sems rin chen mgon gyi= bla ma nyi ma bshes gnyen gyi= tog ge pa nam mkha' rdo rje'i= 'jam dbyangs dkar po dpal ldan rdo rje'i zhal rin po che chos dpal bzang po'i= thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang po'i= rdo rje 'chang kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i= thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i= rje yon tan mchog gi= thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhal du= mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes kyi= paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi= thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i= rdo rje 'dzin pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi= rje btsun blo bzang ye shes dpal bzang po'i= grub pa'i dbang phyug blo bzang bzod pa'i= khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes dpal bzang po'i= rje ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi zhal= thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang bstan pa'i dbang phyug 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i= grub pa'i dbang phyug blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyi= khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun blo bzang dpal ldan bstan pa'i nyi ma phyogs las rnam rgyal dpal bzang po'i=

gzhan yang dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag gnang ba'i bla ma dam pa brgyud par bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du= rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phra mo sbom po las byung ba'i// byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod 'di// dmag zor lha mo la 'bul gyi// bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol// oṃ kā lī de wī sa pa ri wā ra ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ chu dang ma 'dres dwangs ma'i khrag /dwangs ma yi ni khrag chen po// dmag zor lha mo la 'bul gyi// bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol// oṃ kā lī de wī sa pa ri wā ra ma hā rakta a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sha khrag la la sogs bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas// 'bru sna lnga dang sbyar ba'i gtor ma 'di// dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo la 'bul gyi// rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol// zhes sngar byin gyis brlabs pa'i gtor ma de nyid 'bul la/ de'i tshul yang*/ lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ kā lī de wī sa pa ri wā ra sarba bi ghnān sha trūṃ mā ra ya i dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa bdun nam nyer gcig gis dbul/ skabs 'dir ma gcig dpal lha dang*/ tshe ring mched lnga bstan ma dang bcas pa la gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis bal bod gnyis kyi mtshams/ gangs rgyal mo mthon mthing gi pho brang nas jo mo bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ rgyas pa la spro na/ oṃ/ sngon gyi khas blangs dam bca' ma bsnyel bar// tshe ring mched lnga bstan ma bcu gnyis bcas// rnam mang 'khor tshogs dang bcas gnas 'di ru// tshur byon tshur byon myur du gshegs su gsol// e ā ra li hūm̐/

ma ma/ me me/ la la/ le le/ ta ta/ te te/ sring 'gro ma ā karṣa ya dzaḥ dar dkar gyi gur 'ja' 'od 'khyil pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i mgron rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa 'od kyi sbu gu can du gyur pas gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ shrī de wī sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum gyis dpal lha dang*/ oṃ badzra sa ya ma ḍā ki nī ma ma pañtsa siddhi dzñā na sa ma ya i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa'am/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya sarba siddhi dzñā na sa pa ri wā ra kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa gang rigs gsum gyis tshe ring mched lnga dang*/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā dya nutpanna twād na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba tad khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa hi maṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa gsum la sogs pas bstan ma bcu gnyis dang 'khor spyi la 'bul/ de nas/ oṃ kā lī de wī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin tu/ shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ kā lī de wī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ tshe ring mched lnga/ bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis yul lha gzhi bdag dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes nang mchod 'bul/ de nas/ bhyoḥ dpal ldan lha mo dpag par dka' ba khyod// thabs kyi cho 'phrul nam mkha'i mtha' la spyod// byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa khyod nyid la// lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// khyod ni bdag gi mchod pas ma bsgribs kyang*// dpal ldan dbang phyug dam pa thob bya'i phyir// 'dod pa'i yon tan mkha' la char phab nas// mchod pa'i tshogs 'dis dbang po rgyas gyur cig /dpal ldan khyod ni dge sdig dpang po ste// bdag ni lus ngag yid kyi nyes pa'i tshogs// khyod kyi thad du 'gyod pas rab bshags na// thugs rje'i shugs kyis sgrib pa byang bar mdzod// khyod kyi khyad par yongs su 'phags pa ni// 'gro ba'i don mdzad bdag don phun sum tshogs// dge 'dun phrag dog med pa'i spro ba ni// rjes su yi rang khyod kyi rgyud la 'bul// yang dag yon tan ldan pa'i sku mchog ni// nag dang bzang mo 'jigs pa'i cha byad par ma gyur bar du yang*// mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par bzhugs su gsol// de ltar phyag 'tshal mchod cing bshags pa dang*// rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi// dge ba 'di yis ngan song stongs gyur rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs spyan drangs/ de rnams kyi gnas gsum nas yi ge brgya pa dkar dmar mthing gsum byung rang dang lha mo'i gnas gsum du thim pas/ rang gi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dang lha mo'i sku gsung thugs la grib phog pa thams cad byang zhing dag par bsams la/ yi ge brgya pa nyer gcig bzla/ de nas/ bhyoḥ rdo rje 'chang dang lwa ba dmar po sogs// rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma dgongs su gsol// sangs rgyas dngos kyi bla ma khyed rnams la// ma rig dbang gis log lta bgyis rnams bshags// bdag cag gsang sngags theg pa'i rgya mtsho cher// bshes gnyen ded dpon bka' drin la brten nas// sku gsum nor bu len la rab bzhugs te// de yi gegs gyur dam tshig nyams chags bshags// ma nyams khyad par 'phags pa'i dam rdzas dang*// rtse gcig mos pa'i gdung shugs drag po yis// dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas rnams la// bzlas sgrub tshul bzhin ma byas mthol lo bshags// bdag ni sngon chad ma rig dbang gyur pas// sgo gsum sgo nas nyes tshogs ci bgyis pa// sku gsum lhun grub khyed kyi spyan snga ru// lus ngag yid gsum bsam pa thag pas bshags// thugs rje'i gter gyur lha mo 'khor bcas kyis// sdug pa'i bu la brtse ba'i ma bzhin du// rnal 'byor bdag cag g.yel med bskyangs pa la// gtang rag dus su ma thongs mthol lo bshags// bla ma'i sku dgra sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra// bstan 'dzin rnams dang skye 'gro yongs la 'tshe// dam nyams sdig can dgra bgegs de dag la// dbang bskur byams kyis bskyangs pa mthol lo bshags// mdor na bdag cag ma rig dbang gyur pas// mchod rdzas dam nyams rdzas kyi sbags pa sogs// khyod kyi sku gsung thugs dang 'gal bgyis pa// thams cad bsam pa thag pas mthol lo bshags// bshags dang bshags bya bden par mi dmigs kyang*// bden 'dzin rnam rtog dri ma dag bya'i phyir// dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas rnams la// bshags pas nyams grib ma lus byang gyur cig

/ces gdung shugs drag pos bshags pa bya/ de nas thugs dam bskang ba la/ khrag gi mchod yon/ dbang po'i me tog gsur chen gyi dud pa/ zhun chen gyi sgron me/ khrag zhag gi dri chab/ sha khrag gi zhal zas/ rkang gling la sogs pa'i rol mo/ gzhan yang rta nag g.yag nag lug nag bya nag khyi nag go mtshon sogs spyan gzigs/ phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rdzas rnams tshogs par byas/ skong gtor gong gi nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlab/ skong rdzas rnams/ hrīḥṣṭ+rīḥs bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i dpal ldan ṇāṃ/ ā dya nutpanna twad/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ oṃ ru ru sphu ru dzwa la tiṣṭha siddhi lo tsa ni sarba artha sā dha ni swā hā/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs drug dang phyag rgya drug gis kyang byin gyis brlabs la/ rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas/ bhyoḥ gang shar bde stong mchog gi rol par ni// 'char ba'i ting 'dzin pir gyis mchod pa'i sprin// sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon bkang ste// 'dod khams dbang phyug 'khor bcas mchod par bgyi// gdug can snying gi khu ba las byung ba'i// khrag gi rgya mtsho stong gsum khyon gang ba// chal chil rlabs kyi phreng ba mkha' la 'phyo// dmar ser lbu bas g.yogs pa'i mchod yon 'dis// dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang*// gdug pa'i 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang*// thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chags sos gyur nas// bar chad sel zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol// rkang pa phyi ma bzhi po kun la sbyar ro// lha rdzas me tog tshogs kyis nam mkha' gang*// yid 'ong chu skyes sna tshogs 'dzin ma'i rgyan// dgra bgegs mig dang rna ba lce la sogs// dbang po'i me tog phang phung chags pa 'dis// dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang*// dus mtha'i bsreg za dang mtshungs ro sol /tshil chen zhun mar rgya mtshor 'khyil pa'i dbus// ri rab la 'gran skra yi sdong bu la// sbar ba'i me lce gser gyi mchod sdong bzhin// rab 'bar tshangs pa'i 'jig rten snyegs pa 'dis// dpal ldan dmag zor= /phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'gengs pa'i dri bzang can// ga pur thigs pas legs bran dgra bgegs kyi// khrag dang zhag gi rgya mtsho rlabs kyi phreng*// chil chil g.yo bas chu mthongs 'gog pa 'dis// dpal ldan dmag= /'bras chang rgun chang btung ba rgya mtshor 'khyil// dgra bgegs sha khrag phung po ri ltar spungs// sna tshogs bza' dang bca' ba ro brgyar ldan// zag med bde ster zhal zas dam pa 'dis// dpal ldan= /lha rdzas rol mo'i bye brag mtha' yas pa// snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs sa chen g.yo ba bzhin// phyogs kun dal gyis rgod pa'i 'brug sgra dang*// rab mtshungs sa dang bar snang khyon gang bas// dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang*// bhyoḥ rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan rlung ltar mgyogs pa'i bang*// lam lam 'gros kyis stong gsum yud kyis bskor// sna tshogs dar dang rin chen sga srab mdzes// 'dzin ma'i rgyan gyur rta nag tshogs rnams kyis// dpal ldan dmag zor= /rab brjid ind+ra nī la'i ri bo bzhin// drag po'i ngar sgra bsgrags pas ri rab kyang*// ling ling 'dar byed rno ba'i rwa rtse can// stobs kyis dgra 'joms g.yag rog zhol chen 'dis// dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang*// 'jam pa'i spu tshogs char sprin gtibs pa bzhin// sha rgyas zla tshes ltar dkar mdongs kyis brgyan// bai ḍūrya yi rwa bzhi 'khyil ba can// mdzes pa'i rgyan ldan lug nag tshogs rnams kyis// dpal ldan= /'ga' zhig nam mkha' dbyings su khyung ltar lding*// la la lang ling gar gyis bar snang 'gengs// gzhan dag dgra bgegs mgo bor thog ltar 'bab// nam mkha'i rgyan gyur bya nag tshogs rnams kyis// dpal ldan dmag zor=

/dgra bgegs srog la rngams pa'i khyi nag ni// 'jigs pa'i kha gdangs lce rtse glog ltar g.yo// drag po'i nga ros srid gsum za ba bzhin// sna tshogs dar gyi rgyan ldan mang po 'dis// dpal ldan= /'jigs rung bdud sde'i dmag dpung thams cad kyis// mi bzad rdo rje'i mtshon char brgya phab kyang*// 'bigs par mi nus lus la bgos tsam gyis// g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i go khrab 'dis// dpal ldan= /gang zhig btab pas dgra bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs// dus mtha'i me dang phrad pa'i bud shing bzhin// skad cig tsam gyis thal bar brlag 'gyur ba'i// mi bzad rdo rje'i mtshon cha 'bar ba 'dis// dpal ldan dmag zor= /bhyoḥ sprin gyi shugs 'chang dre'u rkyang ser 'di// srin po'i thod sga pags pas rab g.yogs shing*// gong smed srab mthur gdug pa'i sbrul gyis brgyan// stong gsum yud kyis bskor ba'i bzhon pa 'dis// dpal ldan= /dam nyams dgra bgegs phye mar 'thag byed pa'i// mi bzad rdo rjes mtshan pa'i be con dang*// thun dang gdug pa'i khrag gis rab bkang ba'i// mtshan ldan yangs shing rgya che'i nal thod 'dis// dpal ldan= /nad kyi rkyal pa tshon gyi gru gu dang*// re nag gos dang rma bya'i gdugs mdzes dang*// bdud kyi khram shing shwa rde dkar nag sogs// bstan pa srung ba'i cha rkyen dam pa 'dis// dpal ldan= /thod skam dbu rgyan mi mgo'i phreng ba dang*// glang chen ko rlon zhing lpags g.yang gzhi dang*// stag lpags sham thabs khrag zhag thig le dang*// phyag rgya rnam drug li khri'i byug pa 'dis// dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang*// bhyoḥ ri ltar spungs pa'i sha khrag gtor tshogs ni// sngags dang ting 'dzin phyag rgya'i tshogs rnams kyis// ro brgya ldan pa'i bdud rtsir byin brlabs shing*// dar nag cod pan du mas brgyan pa 'dis// dpal ldan= /rdo rje'i thog dang mtshungs pa'i mda' bo che// bya rog sgros brgyan dar nag mgul par bcings// dpal ldan lha mo'i sku dang sngags kyis brgyan// dam nyams snying la bsnun pa'i mtshon cha 'dis// dpal ldan=

/nyi zla ri rab gling bzhi gling phran brgyad// sku gsung thugs dang phyi nang gsang ba'i rten// 'dod yon lnga dang rin chen bdun la sogs// dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin 'dis// dpal ldan= /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gcig dbyangs can ma// gdug pa 'dul phyir drag mo'i skur bstan kyang*// sa bcu'i dbang phyug mkhyen brtse'i gter chen du// yid ches gsol 'debs bla med rten mchog 'dis// dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang*// gdug pa'i 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i= /thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chags sos gyur nas// bar chad sel zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol// yang cung zad bsdus pa byed na/ bhyoḥ dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa las byung zhing*// byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs// dmag zor 'khor dang bcas pa'i spyan lam du// legs par 'byung zhing thugs dam bskangs gyur cig /gdug pa'i snying khrag rgya mtsho'i mchod yon dang*// ri ltar spungs pa'i dbang po'i me tog dang*// gsur chen dud pa'i sprin phung mkha' la gtibs// zhun chen mar me'i snang gsal dam pa 'dis// dpal ldan dmag= /dam nyams khrag zhag rgya mtsho'i dri chab dang*// ro brgya ldan pa'i sha khrag zhal zas dang*// zag med bde ster bdud rtsi'i btung ba dang*// rab brjid sgra snyan rol mo'i sil snyan 'dis// dpal ldan= /stong gsum yud kyis bskor ba'i rta nag tshogs// rnam bkra dar gyi cod pan 'phyang ba dang*// mi sdug drag po'i rwa rtse g.yo ba can// char sprin mdog can g.yag rog zhol chen 'dis// dpal ldan= /'jam legs spu yi gos gyon lug nag dang*// dgra bgegs klad la lding ba'i bya nag dang*// dam nyams srog 'phrog dom dang lce spyang dang*// dar gyi cod pan g.yo ba'i khyi nag 'dis// dpal ldan= /'jigs rung bdud sde'i dmag dpung thams cad kyis// zhes sogs man gyi tshigs bcad rnams btags la 'bul/

de nas chas 'bul ba ni/ bhyoḥ gshin rje rlung gi 'khor lo yis// rlung nag 'tshub ma phul ba na// de la zhon nas sprul pa 'gyed// bdag kyang rlung nag 'tshub ma 'bul// dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i sprul pa khye// ma gcig dkar mo dung skyong gis// srin po'i bong bu gwa dmar dang*// rgod ma rlung gi gshog pa can// sprad pa'i dre rta 'phur shes de// dpal ldan lha mo'i bzhon par phul// srin po yakṣa go ra yis// mgo dang pags pa dre'u yi// sga dang de yi khebs su phul// dre rta zhon nas stong gsum bskor// bdag kyang dre rta 'phur shes dang*// srin po'i mgo lpags 'bul lags kyi// 'di la zhon nas stong gsum skor// dgra dang bgegs rnams thal bar rlog /yab gcig re lde 'gong yag gis// bdud kyi khram bam nag po phul// srin po'i ya mgal snga ru la// btags te dam nyams khram la 'debs// bdag kyang bdud kyi khram shing 'bul// dam nyams dgra bo khram la thob// ma gcig bdud mo dbang med kyis// tshon gyi gru gu sngo dmar phul// srin po'i ma mgal phyi ru la// btags de dam nyams dgra la 'gyed// bdag kyang tshon gru sngo dmar 'bul// dam nyams dgra dang bgegs la khyongs// btsan skya rdo rje zla ba yis// phung byed shwa rde dkar nag phul// blangs te sga yi snga sha la// btags te dam nyams phung la 'debs// bdag kyang shwa rde dkar nag 'bul// dam nyams dgra bgegs phung la thob// srin po bum sna shi ba yi// lhu phrag bar na nad mtsho yod// lha mos 'thungs pa'i kha rlangs kyis// nad yams dal yams dgra la gtong*// bdag kyang nad kyi rdzing bu 'bul// nad yams dal yams dgra la thongs// gsal ba'i khol mo'i rlid bu bshus// nad rdzing nang nas bcus te bkang*// sbrul gyi zhags pas kha bcings nas// dre'u mo'i sgra yi snga sha la// btags te nad rkyal dgra la 'byo// bdag kyang nad kyi rkyal pa 'bul// nad yams dal yams dgra la thongs// khol mo'i gos kyi re nag de// bshus te lha mo'i sku la gsol// gdug pa'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod mdzad// bdag kyang dpal ldan lha mo la// re ba nag po'i gos 'bul gyi// gyon la dam nyams rtsad nas chod// rgyal po chen po rnam sras kyis// seng ge phul ba snyan g.yas kyi// rgyan du byas nas dgra bgegs sgrol// bdag kyang seng ge dkar mo 'bul// drag sngags seng ge'i nga ro yis// gdug pa'i dgra bgegs thal bar rlog

/klu yi rgyal po dga' bo yis// sbrul gyi gdengs ka phul ba na// snyan g.yon dag la rgyan byas shing*// dre'u mo'i sga yi gong smed byas// kha rlangs sdang ba'i dgra la gtong*// bdag kyang sbrul nag chun po 'bul// kha rlangs dug gis dgra dang bgegs// skad cig nyid la brlag par mdzod// lha chen tshangs pa chen po yis// rma bya'i gtsug phud phul ba na// dbu la gdugs kyi rgyan du byas// thams cad dus su skyob par mdzad// bdag kyang rma bya'i gdugs dbul gyi// steng gdon nad las thar bar mdzod// khyab 'jug nag po chen po yis// nyi ma zla ba phul ba na// lte ba dbu la rgyan du byas// dkar nag las 'bras so sor gzigs// bdag kyang nyi ma zla ba 'bul// legs nyes so sor gzigs nas kyang*// nyes byed dam nyams rtsad nas chod// gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje yis// 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma// dbang bskur phyag tu be con gtad// dam nyams dgra bgegs klad la bsnun// bdag kyang rdo rje'i be con 'bul// dam nyams dgra bgegs thal bar rlog /srin gyi rdzi bo dang 'grogs pa'i// rang gi nal bu'i thod pa de// thun dang khrag gis bkang nas su// lha mo mnyes pa'i rten du 'dzin// bdag kyang nal thod dbul lags kyi// lha mo mnyes pa'i rten du bzhes// srin po sha za'i tshogs rnams kyis// dgra bgegs mgo dang khrag zhag phul// thod pa skam rlon rgyan byas shing*// khrag zhag thig les sku la brgyan// dur khrod chas kyi brgyan byas nas// gdug pa'i dgra bgegs thal bar rlog /bdag kyang dpal ldan lha mo la// dam nyams mgo dang khrag zhag 'bul// thod skam lnga yi dbu rgyan dang*// khrag 'dzag lnga bcu'i do shal dang*// sku la khrag gi thig le dang*// zhag gi sor ris thal chen gyi// tshom bus byugs la dam nyams kyi// srog dbugs len la rings par byon// gzhan yang dpal ldan lha mo la// bstan pa srung ba'i cha rkyen du// dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad 'bul// bstan pa bsrung ba ma g.yel zhig

/dam nyams sdig can sgrol ba dang*// dgon gnas srung ba'i cha rkyen du// dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad 'bul// dgon gnas 'di la gnod pa yi// sems 'chang dgra dang bgegs rnams kun// skad cig nyid la brlag par mdzod// dpon slob dgon gnas bcas pa la// dgos pa'i yo byad ci byung yang*// dpal ldan lha mo'i phrin las kyis// 'bad med lhun gyis grub par mdzod// de nas skong gtor 'bul ba ni/ sha khrag la sogs bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas// zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig brjod de/ gong du bshad pa'i gtor sngags kyis gtso 'khor thams cad la phul/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ nang mchod phul/ de nas/ bhyoḥ sems nyid phrin las rnam bzhi'i khyad par ni// sems nyid gud na med cing sems kyang med// don dam dbyer med kha dog gzugs kyang med// rdzu 'phrul sgyu ma tsam du rang gi sems// mthun par bstan pa zhi ba'i dpal lha mo// zhi mdzad zhi 'gyur zhi ba'i ngang tshul can// zhi ba'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i gtso mo ni// rtags kyi sku mdog dkar mo shin tu dwangs// kun tu zhi mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag gi nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod// bhyoḥ sems nyid= /ces sogs shlo ka gcig 'gre'o// mthun par bstan pa rgyas pa'i dpal lha mo// rgyas mdzad rgyas 'gyur rgyas pa'i ngang tshul can// rgyas pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i gtso mo ni// rtags kyi sku mdog ser mo shin tu brjid// kun tu rgyas mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par mdzod// bhyoḥ sems nyid= /mthun par bstan pa dbang gi dpal lha mo// dbang mdzad dbang bsgyur dbang gi ngang tshul can// dbang gi 'khor gyis bskor ba'i gtso mo ni// rtags kyi sku mdog dmar mo shin tu chags// kun tu dbang mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo// khams gsum sems can thams cad dbang du bsdus// bhyoḥ sems nyid= /mthun par bstan pa drag po'i dpal lha mo// drag mdzad drag 'gyur drag po'i ngang tshul can// drag po'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i gtso mo ni// rtags kyi sku mdog nag mo shin tu rngams// kun tu drag mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag gi nad gdon dgra bgegs drag pos sgrol// bhyoḥ

khyod kyi rang bzhin cir yang ma grub kyang*// 'di ltar mtshan nyid cir yang snang ba yis// phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro don mdzad pa la// bdag gis bsgrims te rab tu bstod bgyid na// bdag kyang las rnams la// bdud kyi dmag tshogs dgra la drongs// dmag dpon rgyal mos dmag sna drongs// dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor// bdag cag dus 'dir tshe ring zhing*// 'khor dang bstan pa rgyas pa dang*// /'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*// ji ltar 'dod pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzod// bstan dang bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyong ba dang*// bstan dgra dam nyams dgra bgegs ma lus pa// drag po'i chad pas thal bar brlag pa dang*// thub bstan dar rgyas yun ring gnas par mdzod// khyad par rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas la// gnod cing 'tshe ba'i mi dang 'byung po'i tshogs// thams cad rdul phran bzhin du brlag pa dang*// 'dod dgu'i yo byad ma lus khyod kyis sgrubs// nad yams dal yams dgra dang bgegs la thongs// tshon gyi gru gu dgra dang bgegs la khyongs// shwa rde dkar nag dgra dang bgegs la khye// bdud kyi khram shing dgra dang bgegs la thob// bdud kyi dmag tshogs dgra dang bgegs la drongs// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan pa dang*// ltas ngan thams cad dgra dang bgegs la thongs// mdor na gnod byed 'byung po gdug can 'di// lo dang zla ba zhag du ma bzhag par// skad cig tsam gyis thal bar brlag par mdzod// bdag cag dpon slob dgon gnas bcas pa la// nyin gsum bya ra rgyang nas ma g.yel zhig /mtshan gsum mel tshe drung nas ma g.yel zhig /'gal rkyen sol la mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs// bhyoḥ dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma ti// nam mkha'i khams na bzhugs pa'i tshe// nam mkha'i khams kyi dpal mo btsan// de yang byang shar re ma ti// 'dir byon mthun pa'i mchod gtor bzhes// bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ri rab zom na bzhugs pa'i tshe// 'bar ba me khyer glog phreng 'dzin// lha srin dgu brgya'i lings pa mo// de yang= zhes sogs rigs 'gre/ rgya mtsho'i gting na bzhugs pa'i tshe// me bza' brag gyon ral gcig pa// klu srin thams cad dbang sdud ma// de yang=== /dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi// gtso mo mdzad pa de yi tshe// mi bsrun g.yag mgo thod rlon 'chang*// de yang=== ma bdun gtso mo mdzad pa'i tshe// e ka dzā ṭi ral gcig ma// rnal 'byor tshe 'dzin drod nyul ma// de yang===

/chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i pho brang nas// chos bzhin sgrub pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi// chos ldan phrin las mtha' dag sgrub mdzad pa'i// chos skyong las byed 'khor dang bcas rnams kyang*// sngon zhes sogs gong ltar bya'o// bskul ba ni/ bhyoḥ ri rab lhun po'i gdan steng na// rlung nag 'tshub ma'i gur gyi nang*// dre'u rkyang ser gwa pa'i steng*// kṣa las byung ba'i nag mo ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'jigs pa'i gzugs// phyag g.yas rdo rje be con dang*// g.yon pa yungs kar thod khrag 'dzin// sku la mi lpags g.yang gzhi dang*// re ba nag po'i gos gyon cing*// rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis stong gsum bskor// khyod kyis dgra bgegs thal bar rlog /hūm̐ las byung ba'i nag mo ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'jigs pa'i gzugs// phyag g.yas sdigs mdzub zhags pa dang*// g.yon pa dre'u'i mthur sna 'dzin// chu srin gdong can las mdzod cig /slad kyi rjes 'brang seng ge'i gdong*// sku mdog dmar nag srin mo'i gzugs// phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang*// g.yon pa sdigs mdzub zhags pa 'dzin// seng ge'i gdong can las mdzod cig /bhyoḥ dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma ti// legs nyes tshar gcod rjes 'dzin phyir// khyod kyi ral pa'i gseb shed nas// dus bzhi'i lha mo'i sku yang shar// bhyoḥ dpyid kyi rgyal mor gshegs pa'i tshe// shrī dur khrod gnas nyul ma// rlung nag 'tshub ma'i sna 'dren ma// 'khyags ba'i mig tu sa 'debs ma// ming po rdo rjes las bcol na// sring mo dam can las mdzod cig /yid la brnags pa'i dgra bo rnams// khram la bab kyis khram la thob// sho la bab kyis sho khye zhig /nad kyi rkyal pa kha thong la// tshon gyi gru gu der khyongs shig /nyes can stes la shor ra re// rtags phyung mtshan ma myur du ston// bhyoḥ dbyar gyi rgyal mor gshegs pa'i tshe// sprin bcas mkha' la char 'bebs ma// 'brug sgrog thog gi mda' 'phen ma// sad dang ser ba'i sna 'dren ma// ming po rdo rje las bcol na// zhes sogs 'gre'o// bhyoḥ

ston gyi rgyal mor gshegs pa'i tshe// ma hā shāntiṃ ku ru ma// ri rab kyi ni zom la gnas// phyag na gser gyi zor ba bsnams// spang po de ni kha ser la// 'bru dang lo tog bcud len ma// rdo rje bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs// mi rnams kun gyi bdud gcod ma// ming po= /bhyoḥ dgun gyi rgyal mor gshegs pa'i tshe// rgya mtsho'i gting gnas bka' sdod ma// dpag tshad brgyad khrir dri snom ma// klu la gnas nas mnga' mdzad ma// ming po= /bhyoḥ chos dbyings dbang phyug ma gcig bdud kyi yum// drag mo nam gru tshim byed mnga' bdag mo// srog bdag ma mo dpal gyi rdo rje'i yum// sde brgyad bdag mo dpal ldan gshin rje'i yum// khyod kyi bka' sdod bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas// ma mo 'bum sde nag mo 'bum sder bcas// bdud dang gshin rje srin po'i tshogs dang bcas// dur khrod bdag po zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas// snang srid lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas// bya khyi lce sbyang la sogs 'khor dang bcas// dgra bo'i srog la dbang byed bshan pa'i tshogs// 'khor bcas khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// bhyoḥbhyoḥde ni dam nyams dgra la bhyoḥ /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dgra la bhyoḥ /gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu dgra la bhyoḥ /nad kyi bdag mo 'khor bcas dgra la bhyoḥ /sha za khrag 'thung thams cad dgra la bhyoḥ /dgra bo'i srog la dbang byed bshan pa'i tshogs// dam nyams dgra bo myur du bsgral bar gyis// mthu rtsal dus la bab po sa ma ya// bskul 'di rnams dus gtor sogs kyi skabs dang*/ gtor ma 'phen pa sogs kyi skabs ma gtogs rgyun du shin tu gnyan pas mi byed/ bhyoḥ dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas kyis// mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas la// gzhan gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa dang*// mtshe zor yungs zor 'phen pa bzlog

/'byung po'i thod zor 'phen pa= /gshin rje'i 'khor lo bskor ba= /bdud kyi khram kha ston pa= /ma mo'i khrag zor 'phen pa= /zhang zhung btso dmar 'phen pa= /sum pa glang zor 'phen pa= /bandhe sngags zor 'phen pa= /bon po rta zor 'phen pa= /sngags pa sgong zor= /skyes pa mda' zor= /bud med dmod zor= /mu stegs bar chad byed pa= /ngan sngags gdug pa'i rbod gtong= /klu yis byad du bcug pa= /the'u rang sris la brku ba= /rgyal po'i smyo 'bogs gtong ba bzlog /drang srong gza' yi kiṃ kaṃ= /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi= /ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu= /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// lo skegs zla skegs zhag skegs dang*// nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi= /mkha' 'gro ma dang ro langs dang*// rgyal bsen bar chad byed pa bzlog /de la sogs pa'i gdug sems rnams// thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la bhyoḥ /thams cad gnod pa'i bgegs la bhyoḥ /mthun pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa// dus 'dir bdag la stsal du gsol// 'khor dang bstan pa longs spyod rnams// rgyas par mdzod cig srung ma'i tshogs// de nas gtor ma skyong ba ni/ mtshan mo yin na gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugs/ gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlab/ gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin brlab/ spyan 'dren pa ni/ bhyoḥ rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las la// dmag zor rgyal mo zhes byar mtshan gsol ba// rtse gcig mos pa'i dbang gis spyan 'dren na// thogs pa med par myur du gshegs su gsol// mdun gyi nam mkhar rlung nag 'tshub ma'i dbus// be con thod khrag 'dzin pa srin mo'i gzugs// dre'u'i steng bzhugs gdug pa tshar gcod sku// ji srid dran pa de srid rtag tu bzhugs// phyi yi spyan gzigs nam mkha' khyon gang zhing*// nang gi dam rdzas sa gzhi ma lus khyab// yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin zhing khams kun// rgyas par 'gengs pa 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// dpal ldan thub pa'i bka' srung mthu rtsal can// khyod nyid bsnyen cing bsgrub dang rtse gcig tu// gsol ba 'debs pa'i rnal 'byor dpon slob kyi// 'gal rkyen kun sol mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs/

zhing skyes lhan cig skyes dang sngags skyes kyi// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur zhing*// thogs med dngos grub char 'bebs lha mo khyod// mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso mor mnga' gsol lo// khyod ni srid gsum ma lus kun gyi bdag

/'dod khams dbang bsgyur sde brgyad bran du 'khol// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i srung ma'i gtso// snang srid kun gyi bdag mor mnga' gsol lo// bdag cag dpon slob mi nor dgon gnas bcas// kun gyi srung mar mnga' gsol gnyer gtad kyi// deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i 'bar// rab 'byams phrin las bsgrub la ma g.yel zhig /ces mnga' gsol bya'o// bhyoḥ dran pa tsam gyis dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i// rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma mchog rnams dang*// sku bzhi'i bdag nyid dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i gtso// yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /rab zhi chos sku'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs mang sprul pas bstan pa srung mdzad cing*// sgrub pa po rnams bu bzhin skyong mdzad pa'i// dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i bkra shis shog /chos bzhin sgrub pa'i gang zag skyong ba dang*// bstan dgra dam nyams phye mar 'thag pa la// nam yang g.yel ba med pa'i phrin las can// gdug pa'i 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog /bsod nams dar rgyas ri rgyal lhun po bzhin// snyan grags chen pos nam mkha' bzhin du khyab// tshe ring nad med gzhan don lhun grub pa'i// yon tan rgya mtsho mchog gi bkra= /'bad dang rtsol ba mi dgos pa'i// yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing*// sems can re ba skong mdzad pa'i// bsams pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces shis pa brjod/ dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa 'di ni/ rje thams cad mkhyen pas dus gtor sogs kyi skabs su mdzad pa'i phyag len rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs nas bris pa'o// khams gsum dbang phyug dpal ldan lha mo yis// khams gsum ma lus dbang du sdud mdzad nas// khams gsum 'gro 'di phan bde'i lam zhugs te// khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thob par mdzod// bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i go khrab dang*// bdud dpung 'joms pa'i ral gri mda' bo che// bdud kyi yum khyod mnyes phyir phul pa yis// bdud tshogs dgra las rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog

/rje nyid kyis so// ༈ /na mo badzra bhai ra wā ya/ bla ma mchog dang skyes 'gro'i 'chi bdag gshed// dbyer med bcom ldan 'das ma'i zhabs btud nas// de nyid dgyes byed mchod pa'i sprin gyi phreng*// rab 'byams lha la mdzes rgyan 'god tshul brjod// gnam lo rgyal po gsar ba'i dga' ba dang po'i tshes kyi thog mar/ 'dod khams dbang phyug ma la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i tshul ni/ dpal ldan lha mo'i sku rten dang*/ mchod gtor/ dam rdzas/ spyan gzigs/ phyi nang gi rten rdzas sogs phul du byung ba bkod pa mdzes pa bsham/ sgrub pa po rnams 'khod nas/ nang mchod/ gtor mchod/ dam rdzas sogs byin gyis brlab/ de nas/ bhyoḥ rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las la// zhes pa nas/ thogs pa med par myur du gshegs su gsol// de nas/ rgyun du lha mo khyod bsten no// zhes pa nas/ thugs dam dus bab da tshur spyon// e ā ra li hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥdzaḥ nag mo gdug can dregs pa can// zhes pa nas/ phyag bgyid do zhes dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bzhag ste/ shlo ka gnyis po brjod/ de nas phyi nang gi mchod pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa 'bul/ nyi tshod kyis gtugs tshe/ mtshams 'dir gtor ma rgyas par 'bul/ de min dkyus ltar phebs gtor yan lag bdun pa'i bar bya/ de nas rten rdzas rnams 'bul ba ni/ bhyoḥ sprin gyi shugs 'chang dre'u rkyang ser 'di// srin po'i thod sga pags pas rab g.yogs shing*// gong smed srab mthur gdug pa'i sbrul gyis brgyan// stong gsum yud kyis bskor ba'i bzhon pa 'di// dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i rten du 'bul// 'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i rten du 'bul// rten las ma 'da' 'bem las ma g.yo bar// sangs rgyas bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*// rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod// de nas/ rta/ g.yag 'o ma'i rgyun 'dzin 'dod pa kun 'jo zhing*// char sprin lta bur mdzes pa'i rnga zhol can// rnam bkra dar gyi cod pan mang pos brgyan// nor 'dzin mdzes byed zhol mo'i tshogs 'di dag

/dpal ldan sogs 'gre/ de nas bya khyi nad rkyal rnams ma gtogs/ bla med kyi rten gyi bar du 'bul/ rten 'bul bsdus tsam byed na/ dre'u/ rta/ zhol pho mo/ lug nag gtor ma/ nang rten/ gsang rten/ bla na med pa'i rten rnams 'bul/ de rjes/ gzhan yang dpal ldan lha mo la// bstan pa srung ba'i cha rkyen du// dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad 'bul// bstan pa bsrung la ma g.yel zhig /dam nyams sdig can sgrol ba dang*// dgon gnas srung ba'i cha rkyen du// dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad 'bul// dgon gnas 'di la gnod pa yi// sems 'chang dgra dang bgegs rnams kun// skad cig nyid la brlag par mdzod// dpon slob dgon gnas bcas pa la// dgos pa'i yo byad ci byung yang*// dpal ldan lha mo'i phrin las kyis// 'bad med lhun grub grub par mdzod// de nas skabs 'dir gtor ma dngos gzhi rgyas par 'bul/ de yang kā lī de wī la kha kha khā hi khā hi btags la/ nyung mtha' nyer lnga tsam brjod nas 'bul ba'i phyag len 'dug gtor rdzongs byas te/ gzhi bdag gtor ma phul/ lha la dbang bsgyur ma dang*/ dpal gzugs ma'i/ khrag na bdag mo/ zhes pa'i tshig gcig pu de/ 'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin dbyings phyug dpal 'bar ma// zhes par bsgyur te bstod/ de nas thams cad langs te/ chos dbyings dbang phyug ma dang sbrel ba'i gshegs gtor spyi 'gro ltar bya/ slar gdan la 'khod nas mnga' gsol dang bkra shis brjod de me tog gi char dbab bo// rgyal yum dbyings phyug dbyangs can ma// ma rungs bdud rigs phye ba'i dgrar// sgyu ma'i srin mo ltar ston cing*// sna tshogs 'dod dgu'i 'o rgyun gyis// rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong mdzad ma// de nyid dgyes pa skyed pa yi// chog bsgrigs dam pa'i phyag len bzhin// bkod 'dis dge legs 'bar gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang dbu mdzad sngags rams pa dge 'dun 'jam dbyangs sogs kyis yang nan gyis bskul ngor/

gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis bla ma dam pa rnams kyi phyag bzhes bzhin bris pa'o// ༈ /na mo ma hā kā lā ya/ chos skyong so so'i thugs bkod pas mdzes pa legs par btsugs la/ mchod gtor bzang po bshams/ rang yi dam du gsal bas byin gyis brlab/ de nas thugs rnams bsang sbyang*/ chos skyong de dang der bskyed/ ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim/ phyag drug pa ma gtogs gzhan rnams la dbang bskur/ rgyas gdab/ thams cad la mchod gtor nang mchod dang bcas pa phul/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs kyis bstod pas chos skyong de dang de rnams dgyes nas 'od du zhu bas/ thugs 'od zer rab tu 'bar zhing*/ 'od zer des yul khams dang gnas khang de dang der 'khod pa'i snod bcud thams cad la khyab pas nyer 'tshe thams cad las skyob pa thugs kyi rnam par gyur par bsams la/ brtan bzhugs dang shis pa brjod cing*/ me tog gi char dbab par bya'o// yang chos skyong gi phyi rten 'dzugs par 'dod pas/ stag pa'am shug pa'i shing byang la/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la nas hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ bdag cag dpon slob bam/ dpon g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa dang*/ ngos gcig la/ 'di dpal ye shes kyi mgon po 'di zhes bya ba'i rten du 'bul te/ rten las ma 'da' 'bem las ma g.yo bar/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen sol/ mthun rkyen 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa bris/ tshon dang pra rtsis mnan/ chos skyong de dang der bskyed/ ye shes pa bcug mchod bstod byas la/ zhu ba las byung ba'i yig 'bru gsal ba'i byang bur bsams/ phying pa'i shub bya/ zhol g.yag sogs kyi sog pa g.yas su btags/ chos skyong de dang der bskyed/ rwa dang rmig pa sogs la snum byugs/ phye mar dang nang mchod blud/ bkra shis kyis brgyan par bya'o// zhes pa 'di yang sde pa gzhi rtse rnam rgyal bkra shis kyi nan cher bskul ba la brten nas/

chos smra ba'i btsun pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis man ngag bzhin du sbyar ba'o// 'dod khams dbang phyug thugs kyi sprul pa ni// chu srin gdong can 'jigs rung srin mo'i gzugs// srid gsum dgra bgegs snying khrag hub gcig gis// 'dren mdzad mun pa'i mdog can khyod la bstod// slad kyi rjes 'brang dmar nag seng ge'i gdong*// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur zhing*// khros pa'i zhabs brdabs sa gsum skad cig gis// chems chems g.yo mdzad srin mo khyod la bstod// lha mo'i gtso mo'i bstod pa rnams rdzogs mtshams su bya'o/ bkra shis// ༈ /bhyoḥ rdo rje 'chang sogs rtsa brgyud bla ma yis// bka' bsgos dam las nam yang g.yel med par// bgegs rigs bar gcod bsam sbyor ngan pa kun// zhi zhing ci bsam gegs med 'grub par mdzod/ bhyoḥ srid gsum za byed dpal lha mo// gdong brnyan gnyis dang lha mo bzhi// tshe ring mched lnga bstan ma sogs// bskul la rbad do mthu ma chung*// bdag gi yid la brnags pa yi// bstan pa'i dgra bo'i tshogs mtha' dag /ltas ngan cho 'phrul sna tshogs kyis// spa bkong nad kyis rnam par gzigs// khram la babs kyi======// ༈ /dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo mnyes par byed pa'i gser skyems bdud rtsi'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'dir dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo re ma tir gser skyems 'bul bar 'dod pas nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ gser skyems sbrengs te/ bhyoḥbhyoḥ srid gsum ma lus rdo rje'i dbugs gcig gis// 'dren mdzad dpa' bo chen po khro bo'i rgyal// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje 'bar ba'i gdong brgya 'phro// 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po dgyes gyur cig /chu gter klong nas dus mtha'i me 'phro ba'i// rdzong rnams skyong zhing dka' thub zlog mdzad ma// rgyal kun yum gyur dmag dang zor gyi lha// 'dod khams dbang mo bdud rtsi'i gser skyems bzhes// mi bsrun lha mo chu srin siddha'i gdong*// 'jig rten khams kun 'gas byed gtum drag can// dug gi na bun 'brum gzer ser drag 'bebs// mkha' 'gro'i gtso bzung klad khrag gser g.yur rol// rig byed gnam sa'i 'gyur ba'i gnas re la// dbang byed mkha' 'gro mi bzad 'bar ba bzhin// srog rtsa'i lam phyung raktar sbyar ba'i gser// drag por khol ba'i ro brgya'i btung bar rol// bdud dang srin po gshin rje ma mo dang*// gnod sbyin grul bum sde brgyad bye ba'i tshogs// gser skyems 'di bzhes bdag la sdang ba'i dgra// ma lus thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du rlog

/srid gsum bdag mo 'khor bcas rin chen bcud// dgyes par bzhes mdzod bdag gi bsam pa'i don// kun kyang nyer 'tshe dang bral dus myur bar// bde blag nyid du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// ces srid gsum bdag mo dpal ldan dmag zor gyi rgyal mo mnyes par byed pa'i gser skyems bdud rtsi'i dga' ston zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus gsum gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid 'phags mchog phyag na padmo ngur smrig gar gyis rnam par rol pa 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po rje btsun blo bzang bstan pa'i dbang phyug 'jam dpal rgya mtsho dpal bzang pos bka' stsal ba spyi bor nos te/ shākya'i dge slong blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes kyis sbyar nas phul ba'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
